cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team. The Quality Engineer leads the development and implementation of the organization's Quality Management System (QMS) leading to the organization's eventual certification to ISO 9001-2015.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Creating short- and long-term project plans, including setting targets for milestones and adhering to as well as holding others to those deadlines.
Assisting with the development of company policies, processes and procedures related to Quality and Production.
Conducting or assisting with regulatory and quality training sessions.
Assisting with document control initiated by Quality Control to ensure unit readiness with the Customer.
Delegating tasks on the project to employees best positioned to complete them.
Serving as a point of contact for all teams to ensure team actions are coordinated and remain in synergy.
Communicating with leadership on status and potential obstacles while keeping the project aligned with organizational strategy and goals.
Assisting in the development of improved Quality Control processes including, but not limited to, documentation uploading and picture packages.
Maintaining Key Performance Indicators and preparing for communication to Customers and senior management.
Perform internal audits and assist with regulatory and customer audits.
Providing departments with quality planning and support.
cond_0001.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.
cond_0001.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.
cond_0001.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with quality systems and process improvement work.
cond_0293.responsibilities:
Creating short- and long-term project plans, including setting targets for milestones and adhering to as well as holding others to those deadlines.
Assisting with the development of company policies, processes and procedures related to Quality and Production.
Conducting or assisting with regulatory and quality training sessions.
Assisting with document control initiated by Quality Control to ensure unit readiness with the Customer.
Delegating tasks on the project to employees best positioned to complete them.
Serving as a point of contact for all teams to ensure team actions are coordinated and remain in synergy.
Communicating with leadership on status and potential obstacles while keeping the project aligned with organizational strategy and goals.
Assisting in the development of improved Quality Control processes including, but not limited to, documentation uploading and picture packages.
Maintaining Key Performance Indicators and preparing for communication to Customers and senior management.
Perform internal audits and assist with regulatory and customer audits.
Providing departments with quality planning and support.
cond_0293.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0293.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
cond_0293.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

cond_0294.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team. The Quality Engineer leads the development and implementation of the organization's Quality Management System (QMS), working toward eventual certification to ISO 9001-2015.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
Creating short- and long-term project plans, including setting targets for milestones, holding yourself and others to those deadlines, and regularly communicating progress to the team.
Assisting with the development of company policies, processes, and procedures related to Quality and Production, staying in close contact with relevant departments throughout.
Conducting or assisting with regulatory and quality training sessions, actively engaging participants and fielding questions.
Assisting with document control initiated by Quality Control to ensure unit readiness with the Customer, coordinating directly with the relevant contacts to keep things on track.
Delegating tasks on the project to employees best positioned to complete them, and following up with them to ensure alignment.

Assisting in the development of improved Quality Control processes including, but not limited to, documentation uploading and picture packages, connecting with relevant teams to clarify requirements.
Maintaining Key Performance Indicators and preparing updates for direct communication to Customers and senior management.
Performing internal audits and assisting with regulatory and customer audits, actively participating in discussions and responding to questions from auditors.
Providing departments with quality planning and support, staying in regular contact to address needs as they arise.

Experience or background in quality engineering or a related field.
Familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and quality control processes.
Ability to manage project timelines, set milestones, and hold teams accountable to deadlines.
Strong communication skills, with comfort engaging regularly with leadership, customers, and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of ISO 9001-2015 standards.
Experience conducting or supporting internal, regulatory, or customer audits.
Experience developing or improving quality control documentation and processes.

Creating short- and long-term project plans, including setting targets for milestones, holding yourself and others to those deadlines, and regularly communicating progress to the team.
Assisting with the development of company policies, processes, and procedures related to Quality and Production, staying in close contact with relevant departments throughout.
Conducting or assisting with regulatory and quality training sessions, actively engaging participants and fielding questions.
Assisting with document control initiated by Quality Control to ensure unit readiness with the Customer, coordinating directly with the relevant contacts to keep things on track.
Delegating tasks on the project to employees best positioned to complete them, and following up with them to ensure alignment.
Serving as a point of contact for all teams to ensure team actions are coordinated and remain in synergy, proactively reaching out to resolve issues before they escalate.
Communicating regularly with leadership on status and potential obstacles, walking them through trade-offs and keeping the project aligned with organizational strategy and goals.
Assisting in the development of improved Quality Control processes including, but not limited to, documentation uploading and picture packages, connecting with relevant teams to clarify requirements.
Maintaining Key Performance Indicators and preparing updates for direct communication to Customers and senior management.
Performing internal audits and assisting with regulatory and customer audits, actively participating in discussions and responding to questions from auditors.
Providing departments with quality planning and support, staying in regular contact to address needs as they arise.
cond_0312.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience or background in quality engineering or a related field.
Familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and quality control processes.
Ability to manage project timelines, set milestones, and hold teams accountable to deadlines.
Strong communication skills, with comfort engaging regularly with leadership, customers, and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of ISO 9001-2015 standards.
Experience conducting or supporting internal, regulatory, or customer audits.
Experience developing or improving quality control documentation and processes.
Ability to maintain and present Key Performance Indicators to senior stakeholders.
cond_0312.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
cond_0312.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

Creating short- and long-term project plans, including setting targets for milestones and adhering to deadlines.
Assisting with the development of company policies, processes, and procedures related to Quality and Production.
Conducting or assisting with regulatory and quality training sessions.
Assisting with document control initiated by Quality Control to ensure unit readiness with the Customer.
Delegating tasks on the project to employees best positioned to complete them.
Acting as a coordination point across teams to ensure actions remain aligned and on track.
Reporting project status and potential obstacles to leadership, keeping the project aligned with organizational strategy and goals.

Performing internal audits and assisting with regulatory and customer audits.
Providing departments with quality planning and support.
